svg.title: The structure of Gye Nyame Gold Ltd
svg.desc: Gye Nyame Gold Ltd, the reporting company, owns Nyame Pit and Plant, a mine with three source streams: Haul fleet, Contract ore haulage and Plant grid supply. Its wholly owned subsidiary Gye Nyame Camp Services Ltd leases in Obuasi Camp, a camp with two source streams: Camp gensets and Camp kitchens.
